name: Gazprom
note: Re-rated 2026-09-27 (docs/rating-review-2026-09-27.md): the Russian state controls Gazprom; Russia is at war with Ukraine.

why.text: Gazprom is controlled by the Russian state, which holds more than half of its shares, directly and through companies it controls. Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022 and has been at war with Ukraine since. A famous shirt makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.
